settings.heading: Pick the themes you'll actually use.
settings.text: Choose any 3 or any 5 from the full library. The bundle price is applied automatically in your cart.

settings.heading: Good to know
settings.text: Anything else? Use the contact page. We answer every message.

settings.question: How do I get my themes?
settings.answer: Right after checkout you get an email with a download link for each theme you picked, each with its setup guide. You can download again from the same email any time.

settings.question: Where does the discount show?
settings.answer: In your cart. Add 3 themes and they drop to $75 in total; add 5 and they drop to $99. There's no code to type.

settings.question: Can I mix themes from both bundles?
settings.answer: Yes. Pick any themes from the full library, in any mix.

settings.question: Can I use them on more than one store?
settings.answer: You can install and customise them on stores you own or run. You can't resell or share the theme files.
